data.user_prompt: What are the best white label voice AI agent platforms for agencies?

sections.text:
The best choice depends on whether you want a **ready-made reseller platform** or a **developer-controlled voice stack**. For most agencies, the strongest shortlist is **Autocalls, Trillet, Synthflow, Stammer AI, VoiceAIWrapper, and Retell/Vapi**.

| Platform | Best for | White-label model | Key considerations |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Autocalls** | Fast agency launch and packaged voice services | Full branded portal | Includes client subaccounts, Stripe billing, custom branding, and voice, WhatsApp, and chat capabilities. Its cited white-label plan is $419/month with 3,500 minutes and $0.09 per additional minute.[1] |
| **Trillet** | Agencies wanting a polished, voice-first reseller product | Full white label | Its Agency plan is reported at $299/month with unlimited workspaces, 3,000 AI minutes, phone numbers, custom domain, branded email, and markup controls.[2] |
| **Synthflow** | Nontechnical teams and visual workflow building | Full agency/enterprise white label | Strong visual builder and mature voice-agent tooling, but agency pricing can be substantially higher; enterprise positioning is reported around $30,000 per year.[2][3] |
| **Stammer AI** | Selling both voice and chat agents | Full branded SaaS | Offers client subaccounts, prepaid wallets, and agency branding; it is particularly attractive for agencies reselling voice plus chat rather than voice alone.[1][4] |
| **VoiceAIWrapper** | Agencies that already use Vapi, Retell, or ElevenLabs | White-label layer over providers | Adds branding, client management, and rebilling while preserving provider choice. The tradeoff is managing both the wrapper and underlying voice providers.[3] |
| **Retell AI** | High-quality conversations at scale | API-based, build-your-own | A strong voice runtime for technical teams, but it is not primarily a turnkey reseller portal. Reported usage starts around $0.07 per minute, excluding related provider costs.[3] |
| **Vapi** | Developer-led agencies needing maximum control | API-based, build-your-own | Flexible and provider-agnostic, with reported platform pricing around $0.05 per minute plus model, voice, and telephony costs.[3] |
| **WotNot** | Voice and chat under one branded portal | Full branded portal | Supports unlimited client accounts and combines voice and chat, though pricing is custom and the platform is more tightly integrated with its own stack.[3] |

## Recommended picks

- **Best overall for most agencies:** **Autocalls** if fast deployment, client billing, and predictable packaging matter most.[1]
- **Best polished voice-first platform:** **Trillet** for its agency workspaces, branding, numbers, and markup controls.[2]
- **Best for nontechnical builders:** **Synthflow**, especially when visual workflow design is more important than low cost.[2]
- **Best for voice plus chat:** **Stammer AI**.[4]
- **Best for technical agencies:** **Retell AI or Vapi**, typically behind your own client portal or a wrapper platform.[3]
- **Best for provider flexibility:** **VoiceAIWrapper**, provided the agency is comfortable managing upstream API accounts and costs.[3]

Before choosing, verify five items in a live demo: **client subaccount limits, phone-number ownership, outbound-calling compliance, call-recording/data policies, and whether usage costs include telephony, transcription, LLMs, and voice generation**. Published comparisons often combine these costs differently, so headline per-minute prices are not directly comparable.[1][3]
